title: Lotto Jackpot Climbs to €5,800
excerpt: No winner in Sunday's draw means next week's jackpot hits €5,800. Play online before 6pm Sunday.
body:
No winner in Sunday's draw means next week's jackpot hits €5,800 — one of the biggest in the club's history.

The lotto is the club's main fundraiser and every line played goes straight back into pitches, equipment and our juvenile section.

Play online before 6pm on Sunday, or pick up a ticket in local shops and at the clubhouse.
